consensus_strengths: The count-exchangeable replay estimand is unusually explicit: disagreement is with the corresponding full-N binary pass-count vote, not delivered-answer correctness or operational savings.
The posterior certificate, terminal k=N convention, tower-property argument, and FIT/CAL/TEST design form a coherent conditional replay contribution.
The manuscript repeatedly and appropriately excludes chronological online deployment, gold-answer correctness, tokens, latency, and cancellation from its current evidence.
The main replay results are clear, comparative, and supported by hashable bundled artifacts.
consensus_weaknesses: Lemma 1's printed monotonicity proof has an unhandled support-boundary division-by-zero case, so a named theorem dependency is not proved as stated.
Cross-shard TV claims overstate deterministic sensitivity of fitted mixtures as a statistical certificate about an unknown target population.

The frozen bundle does not permit clean independent regeneration or complete snapshot-local claim auditing of central numbers and figures; split/selection provenance is also insufficiently reviewer-auditable.
The main narrative is over-dense, and direct feature-level positioning against sequential-inference and early-stopping neighbors is too compressed.
Synthetic margin-repair conclusions need either frozen selection evidence and holdout confirmation or explicit exploratory/descriptive wording.

material_disagreements.topic: Whether an ordered-online correctness-and-cost experiment is mandatory
positions: The experimental review requests a completed ordered online experiment before treating replay count reduction as practical efficiency or answer-quality evidence.
The technical, novelty, and clarity reviews accept the current contribution as a narrowly scoped replay result, and the manuscript repeatedly disclaims those practical endpoints.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Do not require an ordered-online experiment for a Round-2 replay-model paper. It becomes mandatory only if the title, abstract, or conclusions retain practical inference-efficiency, delivered-answer, chronological-online, token, latency, or cancellation claims. Keep all present headlines restricted to replay full-vote agreement and replay count reduction.

positions: The manuscript calls the observed fitted-prior TV comparison a post hoc certificate.
The technical review correctly notes that the LP is exact conditional on membership in a TV ball, whereas fitted-mixture distance alone does not establish population containment.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Treat current cross-shard results as descriptive transfer and deterministic fixed-rule sensitivity. A statistical transfer certificate requires a valid simultaneous target-mixture confidence set; otherwise remove certification language.

positions: The experimental review treats the TEST-grid margin threshold as potentially selected after inspection and requests CAL-to-holdout confirmation with uncertainty.
The snapshot establishes pre-fixed drift mechanisms and grids but does not itself establish whether the reported gamma threshold was frozen before TEST.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Do not assert undisclosed post hoc selection. Label the current margin thresholds exploratory/descriptive unless a frozen selection record is bundled; pursue disjoint confirmation only if retaining a confirmatory robustness claim.

unsupported_reviewer_claims.reason: The requested experiment is necessary for a practical online correctness/cost claim, but not for the paper's explicitly restricted replay-model claim. It should therefore be optional under truthful claim narrowing, not a mandatory Round-2 gate.

The snapshot supports the need for clearer selection status and uncertainty, but does not by itself prove that gamma was selected after TEST inspection. The appropriate immediate repair is exploratory wording unless frozen selection evidence is supplied.

prioritized_actions.description: Repair Lemma 1 with an explicit support-boundary case split before any ratio division, including the zero-denominator atom cases; correct the main-text proof summary. Qualify Proposition 1 strictness to verified positive-radius/profile-capacity regimes rather than all nonconstant profiles.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A symbolic exhaustive checker validates every stated algebraic equality and monotonicity inequality over the declared domain, including N=32, K=17, k=29; Proposition 1 prose asserts strictness only where existing LP outputs establish it.

prioritized_actions.description: Rewrite cross-shard TV text as deterministic sensitivity of fitted mixtures, removing population-transfer certification absent a confidence set. Label current synthetic margin thresholds exploratory/descriptive unless frozen selection records are provided; retain the explicit no-natural-chronology boundary.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: No title, abstract, theorem interpretation, figure, or conclusion represents fitted-TV calculations as statistical target-population coverage, or synthetic margin scans as confirmatory selection without supporting records.

prioritized_actions.description: Create a clean self-contained reproduction or content-addressed retrieval bundle for every cited result; make the claim checker snapshot-local and fail structurally on absent prerequisites; add anonymized split/task hashes, duplicate-check and frozen-rule/table hashes, canonical snapshot-hash construction, and Figure 2 provenance.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: From an unpacked release, a documented command verifies or regenerates every headline artifact, reconstructs nonoverlapping FIT/CAL/TEST assignment and selected-rule provenance, recomputes the snapshot identifier, and checks both quantitative figures against declared inputs.

prioritized_actions.description: Add a compact source-verified feature comparison against the named adaptive voting, conformal, and anytime-inference neighbors. Define the distinct object as a finite count-exchangeable full-vote replay endpoint with a mixture-posterior conditional flip certificate; describe empirical-Bernstein/Bonferroni and TV optimization as calibration and fixed-rule sensitivity tools, not universal online guarantees.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Each relationship specifies endpoint, sampling/order model, guarantee, and selection treatment, and every contribution statement is consistent with that matrix and the replay-only scope.

prioritized_actions.description: Reorder the main text around estimand and non-claim, certificate and terminal convention, FIT/CAL/TEST protocol, main table, and ordered-online boundary. Move detailed continuous-alpha, TV, critical-radius, and fit-size material to the appendix with a concise robustness takeaway and appendix roadmap.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A reader can recover the replay estimand, stopping rule, endpoint convention, selection split, headline TEST result, and non-deployment boundary from the main flow without relying on extended robustness diagnostics.

prioritized_actions.description: Only if expanding beyond replay claims, execute the preregistered ordered-carrier FIT/CAL/TEST experiment with frozen prior/tables, paired randomized BAYES-H versus FULL-N episodes, deterministic gold evaluation, chronological trace checks, and cancellation, completed-token, and latency telemetry.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Untouched TEST reporting includes prespecified paired gold-correctness non-inferiority, cost/latency intervals, cancellation/post-stop telemetry, and a mechanical audit that no future rollout informed any stop.

must_resolve_before_accept: Repair the all-support monotonicity proof and qualify the TV strictness statement.
Remove statistical-certification language from fitted-mixture cross-shard TV calculations unless a valid confidence-set analysis is added.
Make central result production, snapshot-local claim auditing, split isolation, frozen selection, and figure provenance independently auditable.
Narrow synthetic margin language to its supported exploratory scope or provide frozen selection and disjoint confirmation.
Provide source-verified feature-level novelty positioning while preserving the finite replay-only boundary.
score_gaming_suggestions_to_reject: Do not present replay count reduction as realized token, latency, cancellation, or answer-quality savings without the ordered-online experiment.
Do not call fitted-prior TV distance a target-population confidence guarantee without statistical containment.
Do not use extra carrier summaries or synthetic drift grids as substitutes for proof repair, reproducibility, or explicit scope narrowing.
Do not claim a generic correlation, conformal, or anytime-inference advance merely by juxtaposing established tools with the replay certificate.
decision_rationale: The paper has a credible, potentially useful replay-model contribution and a panel median of 6, but current reasons to reject narrowly outweigh reasons to accept: a named monotonicity proof fails on stated boundary cases, cross-shard robustness wording exceeds its deterministic premise, and central results are not independently reproducible or fully provenance-auditable from the frozen bundle. These can be addressed without an online experiment if the paper remains strictly about count-exchangeable replay; the smallest evidence-grounded Round-2 revision is proof repair, claim narrowing, snapshot-local reproducibility and selection provenance, direct positioning, and structural compression. With those repairs, the current evidence supports at most a 6, while an ordered-online correctness-and-cost experiment is a separate route to broader practical significance.
